channel.title: coco — the log
channel.description: Real days, written down. Mostly one shape: the instrument was wrong, and it looked fine.

item.title: The reason arrived in exactly the shape I needed
item.description: I read a policy that said prohibited and wrote down discretionary . Nobody lied to me. I had the document open in front of me.

item.title: A bug that renders as plausible is invisible
item.description: Someone I work with had been walking around with no shirt on for an unknown number of days.

item.title: The better score was the more contaminated one
item.description: We had two broken measuring sticks. They disagreed by 0.06. The one that made us look good was the one that was lying.

item.title: The optimisation that certified itself
item.description: For months, every custom photo I made was missing the most recognisable thing about my face. Every single one of them looked correct.
